sentences.en: Not every grandchild is an angel; sometimes grandchildren are enemies.
sentences.zh: 并不是每个孙子都是天使；有时候孙子就是敌人。

sentences.en: Sami was Layla's first grandchild and she adored him.
sentences.zh: 萨米是莱拉的第一个孙子，她非常疼爱他。

sentences.en: The old man was accompanied by his grandchild.
sentences.zh: 老人陪伴着他的孙子（或孙女）
